# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy (Resource)

Use the `ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy` resource to manage a BGP routing policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_account" "customer" {
  external_ref = "my_account"
}

resource "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_prefix_list" "allowed" {
  name              = "allowed-prefixes"
  managing_account  = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  consuming_account = data.ixapi_account.customer.id

  match_list {
    prefix     = "10.0.0.0/8"
    min_length = 8
    max_length = 24
  }
}

resource "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy" "example" {
  name              = "my-ingress-policy"
  managing_account  = data.ixapi_account.customer.id
  consuming_account = data.ixapi_account.customer.id

  entries {
    sequence_number   = 10
    match_prefix_list = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_prefix_list.allowed.name
    action {
      filter           = "accept"
      local_preference = 200
    }
  }
  entries {
    sequence_number = 20
    action {
      filter = "reject"
    }
  }
}

output "policy_id" {
  value = ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_policy.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `consuming_account` (String) Consuming account ID
- `entries` (Block List, Min: 1) List of policy entries (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--entries))
- `managing_account` (String) Managing account ID
- `name` (String) Name of the policy

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Required:

- `action` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) Action to take when matched (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--entries--action))
- `sequence_number` (Number) Sequence number for the policy entry

Optional:

- `match_prefix_list` (String) Name of the prefix list to match

<a id="nestedblock--entries--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.action`

Optional:

- `as_path_prepend` (Block List, Max: 1) AS path prepend configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--entries--action--as_path_prepend))
- `filter` (String) Filter action: accept, reject, or continue
- `local_preference` (Number) BGP local preference value

<a id="nestedblock--entries--action--as_path_prepend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries.action.as_path_prepend`

Required:

- `count` (Number) Number of times to prepend the ASN

Optional:

- `asn` (Number) AS number to prepend (defaults to local ASN)
